piezas.titulo: Reading words: Food and simple orders
texto: Reading and spelling on menus and orders: «ข้าว» has the combined vowel with the long vowel า and the sign ้ over the high-class consonant ข, giving a falling tone. «น้ำ» has the low-class consonant น with the sign ้ and the short vowel ำ, giving a high tone. «ไก่» is written with the front vowel sign ไ and the sign ่ over the mid-class consonant ก (low tone). «เผ็ด» has the shortened vowel with the high-class consonant ผ and the stop consonant ด (dead syllable, low tone).

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «ลูกค้าสามารถระบุระดับความเผ็ดและความหวานได้ตามความชอบส่วนบุคคล» express?

opciones.texto: The customer can specify how spicy or sweet they want it, according to their preference.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «ลูกค้าสามารถระบุระดับความเผ็ดและความหวานได้ตามความชอบส่วนบุคคล» from the text.

opciones.texto: Sharing a meal strengthens closeness between friends and family.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the text, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Freshly cooked rice is the undisputed staple of every meal.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: In the word «ไก่» (chicken), what tone results from the mid-class consonant ก with the mark ่ (mái eek)?

opciones.texto: Low tone (เสียงเอก)
opciones.explicacion: Correct: a mid-class consonant with the sign ่ always produces a low tone.
Incorrect: a high tone on a mid-class consonant requires the sign ๊.
Incorrect: a rising tone on a mid-class consonant requires the sign ๋.
